facts.fact: UNDP says the first digitised birth certificate of the East Region was printed at Bertoua city hall on 5 June 2026 after SIGEC was deployed there and agents trained.
UNDP says it has already supported digitalisation of civil registration in 18 communes of the Far North, North-West and South-West regions, with seven East communes now added.
UNDP says the East Region digital legal identity project is funded by the governments of Korea and Denmark.
